blocks.text: When the numbers of moles of reactants and products in the balanced equation are equal, the units cancel and the equilibrium constant has no units: ester formation in solution, CH3COOH + C2H5OH giving CH3COOC2H5 + H2O, has Kc = (mol dm-3 x mol dm-3) / (mol dm-3 x mol dm-3), no units. When the mole numbers are unequal the value of the constant depends on the units used; in the Haber synthesis N2(g) + 3H2(g) giving 2NH3(g), Kc = [NH3]^2 / ([N2][H2]^3) has units (mol dm-3)^2 / (mol dm-3)^4 = 1 / (mol dm-3)^2 = mol-2 dm6.
